factories.name: newSearchFilesStep
factories.description: Find files and folders by exact or partial name in one folder or across one drive, one bounded page at a time.

inputSchema.description: SearchFilesInput selects one page of items. With ParentFolderID set, the operation reads that folder's direct children, which is strongly consistent; with it blank, it runs Microsoft Graph's drive-wide search, which uses an index that can lag recent changes and requires Name.

driveId.description: DriveID is the drive to search, such as a drivePicker result; blank means the signed-in user's OneDrive and is invalid for app-only connections.

mimeType.description: MimeType restricts results to files of one media type, such as text/plain; blank matches files and folders.

name.description: Name is the item name to match; blank lists every child of ParentFolderID.

nameMatch.description: NameMatch selects exact or contains matching; blank means exact.

pageSize.description: PageSize is the page size from 1 to 200; zero uses the connection's searchPageSize.

pageToken.description: PageToken continues a previous search with its NextPageToken; repeat the same filters with it. Blank starts at the first page.

parentFolderId.description: ParentFolderID limits results to direct children of one folder item ID, or root for the drive root; blank searches the whole drive.

factories.name: newGetFileStep
factories.description: Read the metadata of one file or folder by its drive item ID.

driveId.description: DriveID is the drive that holds the item; blank means the signed-in user's OneDrive and is invalid for app-only connections.

itemId.description: ItemID is the drive item ID, such as a SearchFiles result ID, or root for the drive root.

factories.name: newReadFileTextStep
factories.description: Download one small text file as bounded UTF-8 text without exposing its pre-authenticated download URL.

inputSchema.description: ReadFileTextInput identifies the file whose text is read.

driveId.description: DriveID is the drive that holds the file; blank means the signed-in user's OneDrive and is invalid for app-only connections.

itemId.description: ItemID is the file's drive item ID, such as a SearchFiles result ID.

factories.name: newUploadFileStep
factories.description: Write one file from text or bytes by parent folder and name with an explicit fail or replace conflict behavior, converging on one file when a Step is dispatched twice.

inputSchema.description: UploadFileInput describes one file written by parent folder and name. Set at most one of TextContent and ByteContent; leaving both empty writes an empty file.

byteContent.description: ByteContent is binary content, encoded as base64 in JSON.

conflictBehavior.description: ConflictBehavior is fail or replace and is required. Graph's own rename behavior is not offered, because a repeated attempt would create a second file.

driveId.description: DriveID is the destination drive; blank means the signed-in user's OneDrive and is invalid for app-only connections.

mimeType.description: MimeType is the content's lowercase media type, such as text/plain or text/csv.

name.description: Name is the file name, including its extension; it must be a valid OneDrive and SharePoint name.

parentFolderId.description: ParentFolderID is the destination folder's item ID, or root; blank means the drive root.

factories.name: newCreateFolderStep
factories.description: Ensure one folder with a name exists in a parent folder, returning the folder an earlier attempt or another writer already created.

inputSchema.description: CreateFolderInput names one folder to ensure in a parent folder.

driveId.description: DriveID is the drive that holds the parent folder; blank means the signed-in user's OneDrive and is invalid for app-only connections.

name.description: Name is the folder name; it must be a valid OneDrive and SharePoint name and cannot end with a period.

parentFolderId.description: ParentFolderID is the parent folder's item ID, or root; blank means the drive root.
